name: Comfort UI
author: Local UI Workshop
description:
Comfort UI 0.3.4：补全麦克风说话高亮与真实音量条，修复电平显隐并在静音/断线后清除。原生开关提示音使用独立二维输出，保留原声音、界面音量和提示音开关，避免重复播放。保留柔和配色、五语言、Bing与轻量CPU/Vulkan本地翻译。

198项托管、172项隔离UI检查通过；实际游戏Cohtml/耳机提示音/PC/VR待确认。

Unofficial mod, not affiliated with, approved, verified or supported by ChilloutVR or Alpha Blend Interactive. Modifications may affect performance, security or stability.
requirements: Windows x64 and .NET Framework 4.8; local model download is optional. See repository installation and translation documentation.
changelog: 0.3.4：麦克风语音输入高亮、实际音量条、断线/静音复位、原生提示音二维输出与去重。
